title: In Situ Laser Ablation for the Supply of Atomized Material for E-beam Fabrication
content: Interest in using the focused beam in a scanning transmission electron microscope (STEM) as a tool for fabrication/manipulation has been on the rise [1]. Early results aimed at the atomically precise movement of Si atoms in graphene [2,3]. This approach for reaching atomic precision has its challenges and drawbacks, particularly in the limited number of elements that have been shown to be manipulable using this technique.
